findings.finding: Q1 FY27 (Jun-Aug 2026) net sales should land around $62-68m, above the roughly $60m that the unrevised $0.09 EPS consensus implies: Q4 FY26 printed $66.2m with backlog up 8.7% to a three-year-high $164.4m that management says mostly ships within the fiscal year, a Canadian GES site order shipped at the start of Q1 and is not in Q4, and the RF-power/wafer-fab peers guided their overlapping quarter up strongly in early August.
findings.why_not_priced: Stale estimates and thin coverage: the $0.09 Q1 EPS consensus (Benzinga, Earnings Whispers) traces to Northland trimming Q1 to $0.09 from $0.11 on 2026-07-28 and has not moved in ~70 days, through MKS (semi +28% y/y, Q3 semi guide ~$630m) and AEIS (semi record, +33% y/y) on 2026-08-03/05 and the Q1 shipment of the Canadian order. By my arithmetic (31% GM, ~$17.5m opex, ~14.5m shares) $0.09 needs only ~$60-61m of sales, ~8% below the Q4 run-rate despite a larger backlog. Partly priced: the stock is +9.2% over 20 days and +7.3% over 5, and the 25d skew is -11.65 (calls bid), so some of a beat is held; I sized net of that. Finviz (read 2026-10-07 ~19:20 UTC) shows the stock +12.97% on the week, more than the sealed +7.33% 5-day run-up, and Northland upgraded to Outperform with a $24 target on 2026-07-28 while keeping Q1 at $0.09 and loading FY27 into the back half (FY27 $0.62, Q4 FY27 $0.27): the street's growth story is already held, so a Q1 beat is the near-term upside only; cut again for that new evidence to +2.0.
findings.independence: Company call (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-22-richardson-electronics-ltd-stock/, 2026-07-22: Canadian order 'shipped in Q1... not even in the fourth quarter numbers'; 'most of the backlog should ship within the fiscal year'), MKS Q2 2026 release https://investor.mks.com/node/24426 (2026-08-05) and AEIS Q2 2026 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000927003/000092700326000030/aeis-20260803xex99d1.htm (2026-08-03) are independent of the release; the two peers are proxies for the PMT wafer-fab slice only, not for Canvys or GES. Northland's back-half-loaded FY27 (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=RELL ratings table, 2026-07-28) explains why Q1 is set low and is not independent support for a beat.
